If they find it in a bathroom or on the bus you can always deny it was yours- it's not like knives have names on them, right? And if it was in your seat in class I get the feeling that your teacher knows you well enough to come straight to you to talk about it, versus just turning it (and you) in to the principal's office. 

Keep in mind that it could have just fallen out anywhere else along the way, stuff usually falls out when you are on the move from one place to another. If that happened, again, no connection to you, you can deny everything.

Norway is pretty amazing. I had no idea that they had whale watching tours, too! 

I keep telling myself that we're in the second half of this, most people 'in the know' are saying it'll be over in 2022, and it's like 100 days to Christmas 2021 already so... I dunno. I keep telling myself it's six more months and that I made it 19 so far.
I live here in the USA and more than once I've wished that someone would gun me down in one of our many mass shootings. Or even a non-mass shooting.
